worldcombat.skill.decorate.summary: Works up a bundle of cream and ribbon and sends it flying to another ally; only when the ribbon actually lands do their Attack and Sp. Atk rise sharply, and the ornaments shine on them for a while. A wall or another body can block it, and a lost ally means a miss. The piece needs a wearer.
worldcombat.skill.decorate.use.0: Turn a nearby ally into the main threat before a fight
worldcombat.skill.decorate.use.1: Load both offences onto a partner before they charge
worldcombat.skill.decorate.use.2: Sharpen a companion other than yourself
worldcombat.skill.decorate.description.0: Send a bundle of cream and ribbon flying to another ally; when it actually lands, their Attack and Sp. Atk rise by %1$s stages each. A wall or another body blocks it, and a lost ally makes it scatter - nothing lands from afar.
worldcombat.skill.decorate.description.1: Once delivered, the decoration shines on the target for about %1$s; the Attack and Sp. Atk gain does not end when the shine does - the shine is only the piece's marker.
worldcombat.skill.decorate.description.2: Cast range %1$s blocks; telegraph %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.decorate.description.3: The ribbon travels at about %1$s blocks per tick; farther allies are reached later, and that flight is the opponent's window to strike first.
worldcombat.skill.decorate.timing: The telegraph can be interrupted without paying anything; PP and cooldown settle only after commit.
worldcombat.skill.decorate.preference.th: On: decoration lasts x1.6, at the cost of a 3-tick longer telegraph and 10 longer cooldown. Off: a light trim that shines briefly but comes out faster.
worldcombat.skill.decorate.preference.ai: Both the threat and the ally must be within this distance; larger lets the companion travel further to load a partner.
Engaged: prefer the ally already fighting the threat. Injured: only attend allies whose health has dropped, saving the decoration for a tighter moment.
On: leave a hold post to deliver the decoration to an ally.
